name: Francesco
source:
"There are so many sensations I've never felt before, and I'm making it my mission to finally live my life to the fullest."

Sweet and sun-kissed, someone like him does not typically come to the marketplace. Can you trust this seemingly innocent man, in a place where everyone keeps dark secrets and appearances could be the most misleading of all?

[From [url=https://rottenraccoons.itch.io/obscura]itch.io[/url]]

It was revealed on [url=https://rottenraccoons.tumblr.com/post/700264569337167872/my-dear-tumblrs-i-am-pleased-to-introduce-you-to]Tumblr[/url] that the Stranger's real name is [spoiler]Francesco Sarri[/spoiler]. He is implied to be in his late twenties, also according to [url=https://rottenraccoons.tumblr.com/post/700898711538139136/how-old-are-the-casts-or-the-rough-estimates-if]Tumblr[/url].
